notes.title: Release Date moved
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone, Due to some personal issues we will move the release date of The player RPG one week later.

The game will be released on July 6. 

Why move the release date? 

Well, it's simple as you know we are a team of 2 people working on Eerie Games, and this weekend I (Henry Dena aka Henry Denara) will be unable to stay online to attend to any bugs or problems reported by you.

The game is in the best state we can have it however as you all know, the launch date is very important and IF there is a game breaking bug for any of you I would love to be online to fix it within a few hours like with our first game.

I hope everyone understands.

Cheers!
